fieldValues.statement: A failed read becomes an unknown over a default
fieldValues.boundary_clause: unless the read is advisory and the caller says so, such as the desk skipping an unreadable repo with a warning.
fieldValues.context: lib/adapters return null or "unknown" when a read fails, never 0 or an empty list, so the rules can refuse. Evidence: a failed gh call counted as 0 merges in the bash budget.
